exposure: In vitro fertilization and embryo transfer (IVF-ET)
cohort: 144 patients with prior cesarean section and 166 patients with previous vaginal delivery who received IVF-ET between January 2013 and December 2015
finding: The presence of a cesarean scar may impact embryo implantation and clinical pregnancy outcomes, and increase the difficulty of embryo transfer.
mod_finding: The risk of pernicious placenta previa and postpartum hemorrhage in twin deliveries was significantly increased in the cesarean section group compared to the vaginal delivery group.
gest_age: Gestational age was significantly reduced in twin deliveries compared to singleton deliveries in both groups.
birth_weight: Neonatal birth weight was significantly reduced in twin deliveries compared to singleton deliveries in both groups.
